title: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
title_zh: 死亡率冲击后的社会心理健康与福祉
title_primary: 死亡率冲击后的社会心理健康与福祉
title_secondary: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
authors: Frankenberg, Elizabeth, Sumantri, Cecep, Thomas, Duncan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate the short- and long-run impacts of unexpected mortality on psychosocial health in the context of a large-scale high-mortality natural disaster, the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami. The effects of the tsunami-related mortality measured at the community level are contrasted with the effects of individual-specific loss of close kin using population-representative longitudinal survey data from the Study of the Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. In the short-run, two years post-tsunami, both community and individual-level mortality exposures are significant predictors of elevated depression and post-traumatic stress symtoms. In the longer-run, ten years post-tsunami, individual-level exposures are slightly attenuated but remain significant predictors of both psychosocial health measures; in contrast, community-level mortality predicts post-traumatic stress but not depression symptoms. Mortality is linked to smaller household sizes in the short- and long-run and to less social support in the long-run, although the latter effect differs substantially for males and females. The estimates adjust for other tsunami exposure measures and, in the individual-level analyses, we compare people living in the same community at the time of the tsunami who were exposed to the same community-level mortality rate.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在2004年印度洋地震与海啸这一大规模高死亡率自然灾害背景下，意外死亡对心理社会健康的短期与长期影响。利用“海啸后果与恢复研究”中具有人口代表性的纵向调查数据，我们将社区层面测量的海啸相关死亡率的影响与个体特定近亲丧失的影响进行了对比。短期内，即海啸后两年，社区和个体层面的死亡暴露均是抑郁和创伤后应激症状升高的显著预测因子。长期来看，即海啸后十年，个体层面的暴露效应略有减弱，但仍对两种心理社会健康指标构成显著预测；相比之下，社区层面的死亡率预测创伤后应激症状，但不预测抑郁症状。死亡率与短期和长期的家庭规模缩小相关，并与长期的社会支持减少相关，尽管后者的效应在男性和女性之间存在显著差异。估计值对其他海啸暴露指标进行了调整，在个体层面分析中，我们比较了海啸发生时居住在同一社区、面临相同社区死亡率的人群。

title: Trading Blows: The Exchange-Rate Response to Tariffs and Retaliations
title_zh: 贸易冲击：关税与报复措施下的汇率反应
title_primary: 贸易冲击：关税与报复措施下的汇率反应
title_secondary: Trading Blows: The Exchange-Rate Response to Tariffs and Retaliations
authors: Ostry, Daniel, Lloyd, Simon, Corsetti, Giancarlo, Lloyd, Simon P.
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: TThis paper provides econometric evidence on how exchange rates respond to tariffs. We construct a new tariff-shock database, which captures tariff-related announcements, threats and implementations by the U.S., China, the Euro Area and Canada between 2018 and 2020, and in 2025. Our shock measure accounts for both the size of tariff rates and their economic relevance. Over the 2018-2020 period, we show that exchange rates reacted to U.S. tariff shocks in systematically different ways depending on retaliation: the U.S. dollar (USD) appreciated if the tariff was imposed unilaterally, but depreciated if other countries threatened to retaliate. In 2025, when nearly all U.S. tariff actions were met with retaliatory threats, the USD again depreciated. In contrast to 2018-2020, however, long-maturity U.S. Treasury yields rose in 2025, instead of fell-consistent with an interpretation of â€˜Liberation Day' as a reserve-currency shock. This may reflect that U.S. tariff actions in 2025 were significantly larger, more frequent and targeted a broader set of countries.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于汇率如何对关税做出反应的计量经济学证据。我们构建了一个新的关税冲击数据库，涵盖了2018年至2020年以及2025年间美国、中国、欧元区和加拿大与关税相关的公告、威胁和实施措施。我们的冲击度量既考虑了关税税率的大小，也考虑了其经济相关性。在2018-2020年期间，我们发现汇率对美国关税冲击的反应因报复行为而呈现系统性差异：若关税为单方面实施，美元（USD）升值；若其他国家威胁报复，则美元贬值。2025年，当几乎所有美国关税行动都遭遇报复威胁时，美元再次贬值。然而，与2018-2020年不同的是，2025年美国长期国债收益率上升而非下降——这与将“解放日”解读为储备货币冲击的解释一致。这可能反映出2025年美国关税行动的规模显著更大、频率更高，且针对的国家范围更广。

title: DP42 Factor Shadow Prices in Distorted Open Economies
title_zh: 扭曲开放经济中的要素影子价格
title_primary: 扭曲开放经济中的要素影子价格
title_secondary: DP42 Factor Shadow Prices in Distorted Open Economies
authors: Alasdair Smith
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In a competitive constant-returns small open economy world prices are the appropriate shadow prices for traded goods in public sector cost-benefit analysis. If there are at least as many factors of production as there are goods produced and traded, it is straightforward to derive 'foreign-exchange-equivalent' factor shadow prices. Bertrand (American Economic Review, 1979) has argued that the case of more goods being produced and traded than there are factors (referred to as 'diversification' below) is of greater empirical relevance, and that in this case it is impossible to define factor shadow prices. In this paper, I argue that this view is incorrect, in the sense that if the economic forces which bring about the diversification of production are consistently and explicitly modelled, just enough information is available to define the factor shadow prices. The cases considered are: (i) a small open economy in which the government's objective is to influence the distribution of income, in which case diversification could only result from an irrational use of the policy tools available to the government; (ii) a small open economy in which there are political constraints on production levels in some activities, in which case world prices are not the correct shadow prices for the constrained activities; and (iii) a closed economy (which can be thought of as a model in which world prices are endogenous) in which the shadow prices of goods are not world prices.
abstract_zh: 在一个竞争性、规模报酬不变的小型开放经济中，世界价格是公共部门成本-收益分析中贸易品恰当的影子价格。如果生产要素的数量至少与生产和贸易的商品数量相等，则可以直接推导出“外汇等价”要素影子价格。伯特兰（《美国经济评论》，1979年）认为，生产和贸易的商品数量超过要素数量的情况（下文称为“多样化”）具有更大的经验相关性，且在此情况下无法定义要素影子价格。本文认为，这一观点并不正确——若导致生产多样化的经济力量被一致且明确地建模，则恰好有足够的信息来定义要素影子价格。本文考虑的情形包括：（i）政府目标为影响收入分配的小型开放经济，此时多样化只能源于政府对其可用政策工具的非理性使用；（ii）某些活动的生产水平受到政治约束的小型开放经济，此时世界价格并非受约束活动的正确影子价格；（iii）封闭经济（可视为世界价格内生化的模型），其中商品的影子价格并非世界价格。

title: Culture, institutions and growth
title_zh: 文化、制度与增长
title_primary: 文化、制度与增长
title_secondary: Culture, institutions and growth
authors: Minhyeon Jeong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How do culture and institutions jointly shape long-run growth? This paper develops an endogenous growth model in which individualism, property-rights protection, and innovation-driven growth coevolve over time. Parents choose whether to transmit individualist or collectivist values to their children according to the expected future return associated with each trait, while the degree of property-rights protection is determined in political equilibrium. The strategic complementarity between cultural transmission and property-rights protection generates two steady states – an individualistic, innovation-friendly, high-growth regime and a collectivist, expropriating, low-growth regime – and, for intermediate cultural states, an indeterminacy region in which beliefs about future property-rights protection are self-fulfilling. Institutional quality affects growth both directly, by changing the return to innovation, and indirectly, by shaping cultural transmission and the size of the innovative sector. The framework helps explain path dependence, endogenous regime switching, growth miracles, and institutional reversals.
abstract_zh: 文化与制度如何共同塑造长期增长？本文构建了一个内生增长模型，其中个人主义、产权保护与创新驱动的增长随时间共同演化。父母根据每种特质预期的未来回报，选择向子女传递个人主义或集体主义价值观，而产权保护程度则在政治均衡中决定。文化传递与产权保护之间的策略互补性产生了两个稳态——一个个人主义、利于创新、高增长的体制，以及一个集体主义、剥夺性、低增长的体制——并且在中间文化状态下，存在一个不确定性区域，其中对未来产权保护的信念具有自我实现性。制度质量通过两条途径影响增长：直接途径是改变创新的回报，间接途径是塑造文化传递和创新部门的规模。该框架有助于解释路径依赖、内生体制转换、增长奇迹和制度逆转。

title: Identifying the Impact of Inflation Expectations
title_zh: 识别通胀预期的影响
title_primary: 识别通胀预期的影响
title_secondary: Identifying the Impact of Inflation Expectations
authors: Branch, William A.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Individuals form inflation expectations based on their demographics and locations. Different demographic groups respond differently to sectoral price changes, which we exploit to identify the inflationary impact of expectations. Our shift-share instrument combines national expectations of demographic groups with these groups’ regional population shares. A one-percentage-point rise in expected inflation increases regional inflation by 60 basis points. Long-run expectations (5–10 years) have negligible effects. The estimates are most robust for younger, married individuals with at least a high school diploma, whose expectations mainly influence non-durable goods prices.
abstract_zh: 个体根据其人口特征和地理位置形成通胀预期。不同人口群体对行业价格变化的反应存在差异，我们利用这一特征来识别预期对通胀的影响。我们的份额转移工具将各人口群体的全国性预期与其区域人口占比相结合。预期通胀率每上升一个百分点，区域通胀率将增加60个基点。长期预期（5-10年）的影响可忽略不计。该估计结果对至少拥有高中学历的年轻已婚个体最为稳健，其预期主要影响非耐用消费品价格。

title: Baby Busts and Growth Booms : Demographic Change and the Macroeconomy
title_zh: 婴儿潮衰退与增长繁荣：人口变迁与宏观经济
title_primary: 婴儿潮衰退与增长繁荣：人口变迁与宏观经济
title_secondary: Baby Busts and Growth Booms : Demographic Change and the Macroeconomy
authors: Daron Acemoglu, David Autor, Keelan Beirne, Andrew Scott
official: 官方在线 2026-06-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The secular decline in birth rates across the globe over the past seven decades has slowed population growth, raised average ages, and reshaped labor markets and the macroeconomy. Contrary to the widespread expectation that these trends hamper economic growth, we find lower birth rates are associated with higher growth in GDP per working-age adult across countries and higher wage growth across US commuting zones, with no negative impact on aggregate GDP or earnings. These patterns are not explained by educational upgrading, rising female labor force participation, the declining importance of agriculture, or neoclassical-Solow mechanisms. We argue that they reflect the endogenous, labor-saving response of technology to the scarcity of younger workers. Consistent with this interpretation, countries and regions with lower birth rates exhibit more labor-saving patents and growing high-tech activity. There is also higher TFP growth across countries and industries. Exploiting cross-country variation in WWII military and civilian deaths, we find that declines in younger population, rather than population size per se, drive our results.
abstract_zh: 过去七十年间全球生育率的长期下降，减缓了人口增长，提高了平均年龄，并重塑了劳动力市场与宏观经济。与普遍认为这些趋势会阻碍经济增长的预期相反，我们发现较低的生育率与各国劳动年龄人口人均GDP的更高增长以及美国通勤区工资的更高增长相关，且对总体GDP或收入无负面影响。这些模式无法通过教育水平提升、女性劳动参与率上升、农业重要性下降或新古典索洛机制来解释。我们认为，这反映了技术对年轻劳动力稀缺性的内生性、节约劳动力的响应。与这一解释一致的是，生育率较低的国家和地区拥有更多节约劳动力的专利，且高科技活动日益活跃。各国及各行业也呈现出更高的全要素生产率增长。利用二战期间各国军事与平民死亡人数的跨国差异，我们发现驱动结果的是年轻人口减少，而非人口规模本身。

title: Tax compliance and strategic interactions in a dynamic duopoly model with product tax
title_zh: 产品税下动态双寡头模型中的税收遵从与策略互动
title_primary: 产品税下动态双寡头模型中的税收遵从与策略互动
title_secondary: Tax compliance and strategic interactions in a dynamic duopoly model with product tax
authors: Arianna Dal Forno, Andrea Lorenzo Gallicchio, Ugo Merlone
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model which incorporates intra-organizational structures and bounded rationality into models of tax compliance and strategic firm behavior within a duopolistic setting where two firms with different technologies produce a homogeneous good. A linear product tax is imposed, and firms may choose partial compliance to reduce costs, at the risk of losing profits if tax evasion is detected. Each firm is functionally organized into a Manufacturing department and a Finance department. Manufacturing departments choose quantities through best-reply behavior, whereas Finance departments follow a bounded-rational gradient adjustment rule to update compliance. The interaction across departments and firms is represented by a four-dimensional piecewise smooth map. The unique Cournot–Nash equilibrium may be located either on the interior or at the boundaries of the feasible regions. According to the model predictions, the firm facing higher production costs tends to comply less; furthermore, lower tax rates promote higher compliance. As the system is analytically intractable, due to nonlinearities, boundary effects, and high dimensionality, the analysis focuses on numerical simulation. Tax rate, production inertia, compliance adjustment speed, and technological asymmetries lead to complex dynamics. The results indicate that tax evasion can compensate for cost disadvantages, affect production levels, and generate complex dynamics under the considered organizational arrangements.

title: Circular economy transition of European regions: The role of regulative, normative, and cultural–cognitive institutions
title_zh: 欧洲区域循环经济转型：规制性、规范性与文化认知性制度的作用
title_primary: 欧洲区域循环经济转型：规制性、规范性与文化认知性制度的作用
title_secondary: Circular economy transition of European regions: The role of regulative, normative, and cultural–cognitive institutions
authors: Duygu Buyukyazici, Olivier Brossard, Ron Boschma
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The transition toward a circular economy (CE) represents not only an economic shift but also a profound social and institutional transformation that redefines production, consumption, and policy. This study provides the first macro-level empirical assessment of the CE transition across European regions over the last two decades. It then examines how regional regulative, normative, and cultural-cognitive institutions shape regional CE performance, while also accounting for key confounding factors, including EU cohesion funds, regional autonomy, and the EU Circular Economy Action Plan (CEAP). The results reveal strong spatial and temporal heterogeneity, as well as distinct effects across institutional dimensions. Regulative institutions exhibit the most consistent positive association across and within countries. Normative institutions matter most within major regions, while cultural-cognitive institutions provide more modest support for CE efforts. Importantly, the combination of all institutional pillars is associated with the largest gains in circularity. EU cohesion funds significantly support CE progress, while the post-2015 results suggest that the CEAP reshaped the relative importance of institutional pillars. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of coordinated institutional frameworks and targeted policy support in advancing the regional CE transition.

title: Efficiency in producing life satisfaction: A stochastic frontier analysis
title_zh: 生活满意度生产效率：随机前沿分析
title_primary: 生活满意度生产效率：随机前沿分析
title_secondary: Efficiency in producing life satisfaction: A stochastic frontier analysis
authors: Gang Chen, Puguang Nie, Xibin Zhang
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We employ a semiparametric stochastic frontier model with ordinal outcomes to study efficiency in producing overall life satisfaction. Inefficiency is specified as an unknown function of discrete characteristics using a nonparametric Nadaraya–Watson estimator. A Bayesian procedure is developed to estimate latent variables and model parameters, including the bandwidths of the nonparametric component. The empirical analysis examines the role of the Big Five personality traits and individual resilience, showing that individuals who are more extraverted, agreeable, conscientious, and resilient, or less neurotic, tend to be more efficient in converting satisfaction across multiple life domains into overall life satisfaction.
abstract_zh: 本文采用含有序结果的半参数随机前沿模型，研究整体生活满意度的生产效率。通过非参数Nadaraya–Watson估计量，将无效率项设定为离散特征的未知函数。我们开发了贝叶斯程序来估计潜变量和模型参数，包括非参数部分的带宽。实证分析考察了大五人格特质与个体韧性的作用，结果表明：更外向、更随和、更尽责、更具韧性或神经质程度较低的个体，在将多个生活领域的满意度转化为整体生活满意度方面往往更有效率。

title: Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles
title_zh: 局部均衡思维、外推与泡沫
title_primary: 局部均衡思维、外推与泡沫
title_secondary: Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles
authors: Francesca Bastianello, Paul Fontanier
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of “Partial Equilibrium Thinking” (PET), which micro-founds time-varying return extrapolation: extrapolative beliefs are present at all times, but only sometimes manifest themselves in explosive ways. We formalize the distinction between normal times shocks and “displacement shocks,” and study their interaction with extrapolative beliefs. In normal times, PET generates constant extrapolation and momentum. After a displacement shock that increases uncertainty, PET leads to stronger and time-varying extrapolation, triggering bubbles and endogenous crashes. Our theory sheds light on both market dynamics in normal times and Kindleberger’s narrative of bubbles within a unified framework. (JEL D84, G12, G41)
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个“局部均衡思维”（PET）的动态理论，该理论为时变回报外推提供了微观基础：外推信念始终存在，但仅在特定时期以爆发性方式显现。我们形式化了正常时期冲击与“位移冲击”之间的区别，并研究了它们与外推信念的相互作用。在正常时期，PET产生持续的外推效应和动量。而在增加不确定性的位移冲击发生后，PET导致更强且时变的外推效应，从而引发泡沫与内生性崩盘。我们的理论在统一框架下，既阐释了正常时期的市场动态，也揭示了金德尔伯格关于泡沫的叙事。（JEL D84, G12, G41）

title: How do smallholder farmers adapt to water scarcity? Evidence from the three Gorges Dam
title_zh: 小农户如何适应水资源短缺？来自三峡大坝的证据
title_primary: 小农户如何适应水资源短缺？来自三峡大坝的证据
title_secondary: How do smallholder farmers adapt to water scarcity? Evidence from the three Gorges Dam
authors: Ting Chen, Chong Liu, Sen Ma
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using the initial impoundment of the world’s largest hydroelectric dam as a natural experiment, we assess how farming households adapt to dam-induced seasonal water scarcity. We find that the impoundment of the TGD for power generation has altered the Yangtze River’s water cycle, seasonally reducing downstream water supply and causing rice yields to fall. In response to a persistent 12% decline in yields, subsistence households primarily expanded their farming area to maintain total output. While some households reallocated labor to non-agricultural sectors, this adaptation was significantly constrained by wealth endowment.

title: Gradient-based reinforcement learning for dynamic quantile models
title_zh: 基于梯度的动态分位数模型强化学习
title_primary: 基于梯度的动态分位数模型强化学习
title_secondary: Gradient-based reinforcement learning for dynamic quantile models
authors: Lukáš Janásek
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 September  · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper applies distributional deep reinforcement learning to solve dynamic quantile models with uncertainty. We focus on agents who evaluate outcomes based on specific quantiles of the utility distribution, capturing intratemporal risk attitudes via a quantile level τ ∈ (0, 1). We formulate a recursive quantile value function associated with time-consistent dynamic quantile preferences in a Markov decision process, where at each period the agent maximizes the quantile of a distribution composed of instantaneous utility combined with the discounted future value, conditioned on the current state. We adapt the Actor-Critic framework to learn the τ-quantile of the distribution and the policy maximizing the τ-quantile. We demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the proposed algorithm using an intertemporal consumption model with known analytical solutions, benchmarking against value function iteration. The results show that the algorithm provides accurate approximations of theoretical value and policy functions. Compared to value function iteration, the neural network approximation produces smoother estimates and avoids discretization errors inherent in grid-based methods. As model dimensionality increases, the algorithm scales well to higher dimensions and provides faster solutions with smaller computational requirements compared to value function iteration. The algorithm is robust to various network architectures and weight initializations.

title: Focal pricing constraints and pass-through of input cost changes
title_zh: 焦点定价约束与投入成本变化的传导
title_primary: 焦点定价约束与投入成本变化的传导
title_secondary: Focal pricing constraints and pass-through of input cost changes
authors: Francesca Arduini
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Pass-through rates are relevant in a variety of contexts, such as estimating antitrust damages. It is often asserted that focal pricing, the practice of charging only special prices, e.g. ending in 9s, reduces the degree of pass-through in an industry. This claim has had serious consequences; for example, it has contributed to the dismissal of high-profile antitrust cases. However, it is not grounded in economic theory or evidence. I prove that, in a simple but general framework, expected pass-through is unchanged by the presence of focal pricing constraints. Therefore, the fact that an industry is characterised by focal pricing constraints does not entail that it will also be characterised by a low pass-through rate.

title: Safe havens or war hedges? Asset behavior during the 2026 escalation of the Iran conflict
title_zh: 安全港还是战争对冲？2026年伊朗冲突升级期间的资产表现
title_primary: 安全港还是战争对冲？2026年伊朗冲突升级期间的资产表现
title_secondary: Safe havens or war hedges? Asset behavior during the 2026 escalation of the Iran conflict
authors: Andrea Paltrinieri, Salvatore Perdichizzi, Stefano Piserà
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine whether the late-February 2026 escalation of the Iran conflict revived the safe-haven role of traditional and alternative assets. Using daily Refinitiv data, an event-study design, and interaction regressions with global equity returns, we analyze gold, Bitcoin, oil, and European natural gas (TTF) around the conflict escalation. Gold provides, at best, weak safe-haven properties, with no significant abnormal returns and higher volatility during the event window. Bitcoin offers no robust protection. Oil displays the clearest short-run hedge, but because its payoff is directly exposed to war-related supply risk. The evidence points to war hedges rather than a broad re-emergence of genuinely safe assets.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了2026年2月下旬伊朗冲突升级是否重振了传统及替代资产的避险角色。利用每日Refinitiv数据、事件研究设计以及与全球股票收益的交互回归，我们分析了冲突升级期间黄金、比特币、石油和欧洲天然气（TTF）的表现。黄金最多仅提供微弱的避险属性，事件窗口期内无显著异常收益且波动性较高。比特币未提供稳健的保护。石油展现出最明确的短期对冲效果，但其回报直接暴露于战争相关的供应风险。证据指向战争对冲，而非真正安全资产的广泛重现。

title: Vocabulary aggregation
title_zh: 词汇聚合
title_primary: 词汇聚合
title_secondary: Vocabulary aggregation
authors: Marco LiCalzi, M. Alperen Yasar
official: 官方在线 2026-03-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A vocabulary is a list of words designating subsets from a grand set X . We model a vocabulary as a partition of X and study the aggregation of individual vocabularies into a collective one. We characterize aggregation rules when X is linearly ordered and each word of the vocabulary spans an order interval. We allow for individual vocabularies to differ both in the number and in the span of their words. Under a suitable restriction on agents’ preferences, we show that our aggregation rules are strategy-proof.

title: Multi-level regression and post-stratification for discrete choice modelling and stated preference research
title_zh: 离散选择建模与陈述偏好研究中的多层次回归与事后分层
title_primary: 离散选择建模与陈述偏好研究中的多层次回归与事后分层
title_secondary: Multi-level regression and post-stratification for discrete choice modelling and stated preference research
authors: Patrick Lloyd-Smith
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Obtaining valid answers from respondents has been a central concern of stated preference (SP) studies. In contrast, sample representativeness is the main focus of current public polling accuracy debates, largely due to declining survey response rates. We introduce the multi-level regression and post-stratification (MRP) modelling approach to welfare estimation using discrete choice models. Through Monte Carlo simulations and two water resource valuation surveys, we demonstrate how MRP can help researchers to (i) generate population-relevant welfare measures from non-representative samples, (ii) estimate preference heterogeneity and distributional impacts across people, and (iii) evaluate the impacts of removing potentially invalid responses using a consistent target population frame. We propose MRP as a complementary modelling approach for non-market valuation data and discuss its opportunities and limitations.

title: The earnings effect of digital life: evidence from internet use
title_zh: 数字生活的收入效应：来自互联网使用的证据
title_primary: 数字生活的收入效应：来自互联网使用的证据
title_secondary: The earnings effect of digital life: evidence from internet use
authors: Yongkang Chen Xinmin Chen School of Economics and Management, South China Normal University, Guangzhou, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the context of the rapid growth in earnings and internet penetration in China, this study investigates the impact of internet use on earnings. Using a panel data from China Family Panel Study 2010, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022，this study finds that internet use promotes earnings growth in China. The benefits of internet use are more pronounced for those born after 1970, the high-educated, and the rural residents. Further investigations reveal three underlying mechanisms, including promoting non-agricultural employment, facilitating multiple jobholding and improving social capital.
abstract_zh: 在中国收入与互联网普及率快速增长的背景下，本研究探讨了互联网使用对收入的影响。基于中国家庭追踪调查2010、2014、2016、2018、2020、2022年的面板数据，本研究发现互联网使用促进了中国居民的收入增长。对于1970年后出生群体、高学历人群及农村居民而言，互联网使用的收益更为显著。进一步研究揭示了三种潜在机制：促进非农就业、推动多重职业参与以及提升社会资本。
